**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Miss Medhurst](../persons.html#988),
Thanks for your poem.

You will probably be here on Saturday in time for am [sic] morning service, which is at ten o’clock.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Dated on the assumption that the poem was \'New Year\'s Eve\', which was published in MP in December 1873.
